02Department of Health

Website Design
UI/UX
Interaction Design

Making health information easier to find through clearer topic groups and more consistent navigation.

about

A concept redesign focused on making health information easier to find. Research with 10+ users informed the navigation, topic groups and responsive screens. I contributed across all stages with the team, from research, testing and information architecture to wireframes, UI design and prototyping.

01userflows

We mapped how people find a health topic and reach relevant information, using clearer groups to guide the journey.

before the redesign

The original Resources page had competing search bars and inconsistent selection cues. Important filters were also difficult to find.

These findings shaped clearer topic groups and more consistent navigation cues.

information architecture

Card sorting informed the topic groups and labels. The revised sitemap separates public and professional pathways, with related information grouped together.

02wireframes

Wireframes explored a scannable Topics page and a consistent article structure. Desktop and mobile testing highlighted menu visibility and search as areas to refine.

Testing exposed inconsistent hover and click behaviour. Navigation iterations explored clearer entry points, grouped dropdowns and visible search.

03design system

Shared typography, colour and interface components support consistency across desktop and mobile. The final prototype demonstrates the proposed experience; usability improvements have not been measured.
